meta.beschrijving: The magic that stays, long after the paint is gone. Calm flower sessions at home for mothers and daughters, small girls' parties and highly sensitive children.

hero.ondertitel: The magic that stays, long after the paint is gone
hero.tekst: I let children experience themselves as magic. Small, calm and with all the time in the world: a mother and daughter together, a handful of friends at a birthday, or a child who feels a lot and for that very reason sits still the longest.

tekst: An afternoon of learning to paint on skin. You start with a single line and by the end there is a flower on your neighbour's arm.
I show you how paint behaves on skin, how to work with two colours at once and where to place glitter and gems so the light finds them.
All materials are ready for you. Come with empty hands and zero experience, just a willingness to get them dirty.
evenement.prijsToelichting: materials, tea and something sweet included
evenement.wachtlijst: Add me to the waiting list

aanbod.intro: Every session holds a moment where someone truly sees herself. I work with small groups, in a calm place, usually at your home. Choose what suits your moment.

items.kort: Side by side at the mirror, both painted, and photos to keep. An afternoon that revolves around just the two of you.
beschrijving: You arrive together and sit down next to each other. She chooses first, then you, and then I paint you both.
It is about the mirror. About the moment she sees herself and goes completely quiet, and about you sitting beside her with flowers on your own shoulder.
We finish with photos. You receive those a few days later.
There is all the time in the world. For children who feel a lot that means looking first, touching next, and painting only when she is ready.
praktisch: At your home or in my studio
Photos arrive a few days later

items.kort: Ninety minutes at your home, for one to three children, with a paint case and a lit mirror. Perfect for a small birthday party.
items.voor: Sensitive children, around four to seven
beschrijving: For children who are quickly overwhelmed at a busy party and still long to feel magic on their birthday. I come to you and turn the kitchen table into a place where everything revolves around her.

We begin with a small ritual. The children open the paint case together and discover the colours, the glitter and the examples. We lay everything out calmly and there is all the time in the world to look, to touch and to tell me what they love.
Then I paint them one by one. Elegant flowers, soft colours, fine glitter, tuned to each child. In a lit mirror she follows how her face comes to life step by step.
The experience is deliberately slow. It is exactly in that calm that wonder appears, and a memory that lasts for years. I work from experience rather than entertainment.
praktisch: An hour and a half at your home, in a familiar and safe setting
For one to three children, so each child gets my full attention
Includes preparation, materials, the creative experience and a moment of rest
At the kitchen table in a tidy room. The quieter the room, the deeper the children go into it
During the experience all my attention is with the children. Afterwards I love to hear your reactions and questions
Head outside together afterwards, to the playground or the library. The warm reactions they get there make the feeling even bigger

items.kort: A small group of girls learns to paint on skin. Everyone goes home with a flower on a friend's arm. On request, from four to six participants.
items.voor: A group of four to six girls
beschrijving: A small group of girls, a table full of colour, and an afternoon to learn it yourself. I show you how paint behaves on skin, how to let a line grow and where to place glitter and gems so the light finds them.
They practise on a board first, then on each other. Everyone goes home with a flower on a friend's arm, and with the feeling that she made it herself.
All materials are ready for you. Come with empty hands and zero experience, just a willingness to get them dirty.
praktisch: For a group of four to six girls
At your home or another calm place
All materials are ready, no experience needed
On request. We agree on the length and the price together

items.kort: Your pregnant belly as a flower garden, painted in about an hour. Calm, at your home, with photos to remember it by.
beschrijving: We start with a cup of tea and a conversation about what you love. Flowers, vines, stars, or something that only means something to you.
Then I paint straight onto your belly with skin friendly paint. You lie or sit comfortably, and you are welcome to fall asleep.
We finish with photos, so you keep this belly forever. The paint rinses off in the shower.
praktisch: Wear something paint is welcome on

items.kort: Flowers around the eye, gold on the cheek, gems where the light falls.
beschrijving: No tigers and spiders, but flowers growing around the eye, with glitter and small gems set into them.
Each face takes five to ten minutes, so a good queue moves through in two hours.
Suitable from around three years old. All materials are skin friendly and cosmetically approved.
I work at eye level and say what I am doing. Children who find it exciting can watch from their mother's lap first.
praktisch: Five to ten minutes per face

items.kort: White lines, fine curls and dots that grow around the wrist.
beschrijving: A flower on the back of the hand, with white dots running towards the fingers like a little chain. Small work, made to be studied up close.
I draw in white lines with a fine brush, with turquoise and pink underneath as a background and gold running through it.
Lovely for anyone who would rather show their hands than their face, and a beautiful addition to a painted face.
praktisch: Stays put until you wash it off
Comfortable for children who prefer to keep their face free

stappen.tekst: Tell me about the day, the place and who it is for. I work with small groups in a calm place; together we look at whether that fits. I let you know within two days whether I am free.
Colours, flowers, an animal, a hero. She chooses, and I let it grow from the very first line.
The moment it is all about: she looks, she goes quiet, and she sees herself exactly as she is.
The paint comes off with water and soap. What remains is the memory of an afternoon that revolved entirely around her.

voorwie.intro: La Flora is for you if you recognise something here.
punten: You love flowers, leaves, vines and things that glitter.
Your child feels a lot, and you want someone who asks before she touches.
You are looking for a moment that revolves entirely around her, not around the clock.
You find calm and attention more important than speed and numbers.
You want photos you will still look at years from now.

items.antwoord: Flowers, in every kind. Roses, lotuses, small wild flowers, leaves and vines, with glitter and gems where the light falls. Sometimes a butterfly or a star in between. Everything that is soft, light and organic. That is my handwriting and it is what I am best at.

items.vraag: My child wants a spider or a dragon. Is that possible?
items.antwoord: With me everything becomes a flower. A spider becomes a star flower with eight petals, a dragon a vine of fire-coloured flowers along the arm. She chooses the idea, I translate it into my language. For tough animals and monsters as you know them from the fairground a classic children's face painter is the better choice; that way everyone does their own thing.

Then I paint happy skulls: cheerful skulls full of flowers, in the style of the Mexican Día de los Muertos. Colourful, with roses around the eyes and glitter on the cheeks. Festive rather than frightening.
From around four years old, and there is no upper limit. Mothers, teenagers and pregnant bellies are just as welcome as little girls.
One to three for a flower experience, four to six for a teen workshop. That way everyone has all the time in the world at the mirror.
At your home, or in a calm place we choose together. I bring everything: paint, glitter, a mirror and light.

items.vraag: How long does it stay on?
items.antwoord: A day, sometimes two. With water and soap it comes right off. The photos stay.
I work with professional, skin-friendly face paint and cosmetic glitter. For sensitive skin I test a small patch on the hand first.

items.vraag: Can I give it as a gift?
items.antwoord: Yes, a session makes a lovely gift for a birthday, a baby shower or just because. Send me a message and I will turn it into a gift voucher.

tekst: I am Jasmina, an artist with a love for flowers, lines and glitter. I paint slowly. First you feel the brush on your hand, only then on your face. I say what I am about to do before I do it, and we stop the moment you want to. That is why I work small, so that I can really see every child.

For children who feel a lot, that makes all the difference. All the time in the world, gentle hands, and someone who asks before she touches. Parents of highly sensitive children know how rare that is, and those children often sit still the longest.

I work from experience. My work is built with care, driven by a love of detail and feeling. What I bring is paint, glitter, a mirror and the calm to really take my time. At your home, at your venue or on the festival grounds.

boeken.tekst: Send a message with the date, the place and what you have in mind. A small group, a calm place, all the time in the world: that is what I am best at. I reply within two days.
